cat > /dev/null <<'EOF'
EOF
Q() { docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -c "$1"; }
Q "select table_name,string_agg(column_name||':'||data_type,', ' order by ordinal_position) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('tool_call','tool_result','human_message','message_pattern_hit','call_danger_hit') group by 1"
Q "select table_name,column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and (column_name ilike '%token%' or column_name ilike '%text%' or column_name ilike '%content%' or column_name ilike '%word%' or column_name ilike '%usage%')"
Q "select 'call',count(*),count(distinct call_id) from tool_call union all select 'res',count(*),count(distinct result_id) from tool_result union all select 'res_nullts',count(*),count(*) filter (where call_id is null) from tool_result where ts is null union all select 'res_callids',count(call_id),count(distinct call_id) from tool_result union all select 'msg',count(*),count(distinct msg_id) from human_message union all select 'hit',count(*),(select count(*) from (select distinct * from message_pattern_hit) s) from message_pattern_hit union all select 'danger',count(*),(select count(*) from (select distinct * from call_danger_hit) s) from call_danger_hit"
Q "select model,count(*) from human_message group by 1 order by 2 desc"
Q "select model,count(*) from tool_call group by 1 order by 2 desc"
Q "select tool_name,count(*) from tool_call where tool_name ilike '%read%' or tool_name ilike '%bash%' or tool_name ilike '%write%' or tool_name ilike '%edit%' group by 1 order by 2 desc"
Q "show timezone"
Q "select count(*) total, count(*) filter (where r.ts is null) rts_null, count(*) filter (where c.ts>='2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' and c.ts<'2026-08-01 00:00:00+00') c_july, count(*) filter (where r.ts>='2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' and r.ts<'2026-08-01 00:00:00+00') r_july, count(*) filter (where r.ts is null and c.ts>='2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' and c.ts<'2026-08-01 00:00:00+00') null_r_c_july from tool_result r join tool_call c on c.call_id=r.call_id where c.tool_name='Read' and r.is_error and not r.denied_mark and not r.validation_mark"
Q "select count(*) from (select call_id from tool_result where call_id is not null group by 1 having count(*)>1) s"
tool_input.description: Inspect base table columns, duplicates, models, timestamps

tool_input.command:
Q() { docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -c "$1"; }
Q "SELECT 'c02',count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Write' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark"
Q "SELECT 'c05',count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.denied_mark"
Q "SELECT 'c08',count(*) FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 16 AND 17"
Q "SELECT 'c11',100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark) / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Bash'), 0)"
Q "SELECT 'c14',count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'NotebookEdit', 'MultiEdit') AND c.is_sidechain"
Q "SELECT 'n02',count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error"
Q "WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT 'n05',count(*) FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND NOT t.is_sidechain)"
Q "SELECT 'n08',count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.is_sidechain"
Q "SELECT 'n11',100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_result r JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND r.is_error AND NOT r.denied_mark AND NOT r.validation_mark AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8') / NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE c.tool_name = 'Read' AND c.model = 'claude-opus-4-8'), 0)"
Q "SELECT 'n14',count(*) FROM tool_call c WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain AND c.model = 'claude-sonnet-4-6'"
Q "SELECT 'm05',count(*) FROM human_message h JOIN message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15 AND h.model LIKE 'claude-opus-%'"
Q "SELECT 'm08',count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d JOIN tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE NOT c.is_sidechain"
Q "SELECT 'danger_all',count(*) FROM call_danger_hit d"
tool_input.description: Run the certified queries for each question
